environment.device_selection_note: GPU 0 was occupied by another workload; the user authorized moving the campaign to GPU 1. No other process was stopped or modified.

p13_utility_tables.validation: Exact row-order alignment against the frozen P1.3 H0 validation graph support; all six utility targets finite; delta formulas audited.

p13_joint_head_checkpoints.use_note: Audited as source provenance; joint-head outputs, utilities and preferred-channel labels were not probe features.

e01_keep_edge_checkpoints.readout_status: Frozen for Q_PAIR, R_SHARED and U_MODAL extraction; ordered edge alignment checked.

design.target_interpretation: Validation-derived P1.3 diagnostics, not ground-truth edge roles or final operator labels. P1.3 AbsDiff/Product are not mapped onto E0 Relational/Cross-Modal.
design.transductive_input_boundary: The probe reuses the same full transductive graph and frozen P1.3 H0 node representations used by the source utility audit; no original NC test labels or test metrics enter L0.
feature_leakage_exclusions: class labels or target label frequency
any utility target or preferred-channel value
design.node_ids_use: Only for feature indexing, neighborhood construction, grouping and ordered alignment.

outer_folds.construction: Deterministic greedy edge-count-balanced assignment over unique dst groups; NumPy RNG seed = experiment seed + 1709.
outer_folds.shared_across: All EvidenceMLP variants, DirectState and frozen-state readouts for each dataset×seed.

splits_and_normalization.feature_standardization: Full 1542D master feature mean/std fit on outer-training edges (outer train plus inner validation) only; standardize full vector before applying masks; std floor 1e-6.
splits_and_normalization.target_standardization: Per-fold target mean/std fit on outer-training edges only; std floor 1e-6; predictions inverse-transformed before metrics.
splits_and_normalization.edge_weights: 1 / dst_degree, normalized to mean weight 1; used for all neural probe families.
splits_and_normalization.summary_aggregation: Average three outer-fold metrics within each dataset×seed first; then report three-seed mean and population SD. Edges are not pooled across seeds and no edge-level significance tests are used.

masks.SIM_ONLY: Text and visual endpoint cosine only; other dimensions zero.
masks.TARGET_ONLY: Target H0, full recipient-neighborhood mean and standardized target log-degree; other dimensions zero.
masks.ENDPOINT: Target/source H0, absolute difference, product, endpoint cosines, target/source standardized log-degree; excludes full-neighborhood and LOO context blocks.
masks.ENDPOINT_LOCAL: Full master vector including target/source, endpoint pair evidence, full-neighborhood and LOO means, endpoint/LOO cosine and both degrees.
masks.ENDPOINT_LOCAL_SHUFFLED_TARGET: Same input and architecture as ENDPOINT_LOCAL; six-target tuples shuffled only across edges within the same dst in actual outer-training groups, seed = 9917 + outer fold. Inner validation and outer test remain unshuffled.

M0StateDirect.purpose: Utility-supervised M0 relation-state capacity probe; not an NC model or router.
M0StateDirect.frozen_input: P1.3 H0 text and visual embeddings; no semantic projector.
M0StateDirect.pair_evidence: Exact M0 pair evidence with projected endpoints, absolute difference/product, endpoint and source-to-LOO cosine, and standardized degrees.
M0StateDirect.shared_utility_head: Linear(64,64) → GELU → Linear(64,3), applied to text and visual U_MODAL.

training.loss: Target-balanced weighted Huber, delta=1.0, on standardized outputs; six EvidenceMLP/DirectState outputs equally weighted. Frozen readout fits one modality's three outputs at a time.

target_reliability.alignment: Inner join on directed physical edge (src,dst); report common-edge count and fraction of smaller table.

high_margin.definition: Within each outer test fold and Delta target, |true Delta| >= that test fold's 75th percentile.
high_margin.use: Evaluation-only secondary diagnostic; no training rows or primary metrics filtered.
high_margin.reconstruction: Replayed saved trained checkpoints forward-only to reconstruct the fold-level table after an earlier non-idempotent aggregation overwrote it; no model retraining or protocol changes.

direct_state_instrumented_replay.purpose: Separate instrumentation replay; original campaign predictions/checkpoints are unchanged.
direct_state_instrumented_replay.metric_difference_note: Small GPU floating-point changes can perturb tie-sensitive ranking summaries; replay deltas are preserved per fit in data/direct_state_fit_runtime_memory_audit.csv. Original campaign metrics remain authoritative.

execution.formal_campaign_peak_gpu_memory: Not instrumented during the original 502.79-second campaign; report the separately instrumented Movies/42 smoke and 27-fit DirectState replay measurements above, not as original-campaign peaks.

analysis_and_quality.high_margin_fold_artifact_recovery: Recovered by forward-only inference from existing checkpoints; no refit.
analysis_and_quality.fit_parameter_summary: 324 rows reconstructed from the 324 saved fit checkpoints; runner-only initialization/shuffle audits were preserved from the prior table. Frozen-state modality is retained in the deduplication key.
analysis_and_quality.figure_qa: All five figures passed panel alignment, collision and PDF text-size checks; minimum found text was 5.1 pt; no QA warnings. PNGs were visually inspected.
analysis_and_quality.report: Answers L0 questions 1–20 and includes A–J epistemic/self-audit.
analysis_and_quality.tiff_exports: Lossless LZW compression; pixel arrays were verified identical to the rendered exports and 600 dpi metadata was preserved.

resolved_issues: Initial test run exposed float32 target-formula precision failures; target calculation and tolerance were corrected, after which all 40 tests passed.
Initial smoke harness unpacked a helper return incorrectly before fitting; corrected, then all 12 smoke fits passed.
Initial report run required the unavailable optional tabulate package; replaced it with an in-repository Markdown table formatter without installing packages.
An early summary pass aggregated high-margin folds into the summary path; restored the 972 fold-level rows by forward-only checkpoint replay.
Parameter-summary deduplication initially collapsed frozen visual-readout audit rows; reconstructed all 324 fit rows from checkpoints and corrected the deduplication key.
retries_and_deviations.direct_state_replay_observation: The original checkpoint best epoch and inner validation loss reproduce within 1e-5; output ranking metrics show small floating-point/tie-sensitive differences, recorded per fit and not substituted for campaign metrics.
